parole.testo: Attested since 1790s, probably from Khakas тайға (tayğa, “taiga; mountain”) or a related (extinct?) Turkic language, further origin unknown. Meaning 'forest', likely developed in Turkic from the original 'mountain' (cf. Tuvan тайга (tayga, “mountain”)), first attested in 1735 in some "Chulym Tatar"

parole.significato: a Khakas stringed musical instrument, similar to morin khuur
